class: Identity verification channel mistaken for contact data
symptom: An email-or-phone verification choice received a phone number, then an unrelated AI paragraph, rather than an offered channel.
root_cause: Contact-data recognition ran before recognizing the identity verification channel options.
why_tests_missed: Verification tests focused on code entry and did not cover channel questions mentioning phone number.
fix: When both email and phone channels are offered for identity verification, select the uniquely matching saved contact preference before contact-fact matching. Code and credential gates remain unchanged.
prevention: Check semantic answer type against offered choices before interpreting contact keywords.
